title: Hold progress and retention payments in trust accounts
what: As the head contractor on a contract that needs a project trust, open a project trust account within 20 business days of the first subcontract, and open a retention trust account before withholding retention amounts.

laws.title: Building Industry Fairness (Security of Payment) Act 2017 (Qld)

sources.title: Building Industry Fairness (Security of Payment) Act 2017 (Qld)
sources.quote: If a project trust is required for a contract under section 12 , the contracted party must open an account at a financial institution for the trust as required by this section

sources.title: Building Industry Fairness (Security of Payment) Act 2017 (Qld)
sources.quote: The project trust account must be opened within 20 business days after the contracted party enters into the first subcontract
